classes.summary: DevicesMFE is a Page Object Model class for HP Smart web application's device management micro-frontend. Key patterns include: (1) Separation of verification and action flows with clear section comments; (2) Extensive use of wait_for_object with configurable timeouts and exception handling; (3) Multi-screen popup flow handling for What's New feature with navigation methods (next, back, done); (4) Alpha/workaround code for Windows dummy printer testing due to printer addition limitations; (5) JavaScript executor usage for interacting with non-displayed elements (close button); (6) Keyboard interaction using Selenium Keys for refresh functionality (Ctrl+R); (7) Login state verification through element invisibility checks; (8) Text extraction methods for popup validation; (9) Consistent naming convention with verify_* for assertions and click_/get_* for actions; (10) Support for both displayed and non-displayed element verification. The class demonstrates a comprehensive test automation framework for device management UI with robust error handling and flexible timeout configurations.
